# watchpoint_deployment (Resource)

A deployment marker records a release for correlation with check results. This resource has no update endpoint; any change recreates the marker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_deployment" "example" {
  version     = "v2.3.1"
  service     = "api-server"
  environment = "production"
  monitor_ids = ["mon_abc123"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version` (String) Release version, e.g. `v2.3.1` or a commit short SHA.

### Optional

- `commit_hash` (String) Commit hash for the release.
- `commit_url` (String) Link to the commit in GitHub/GitLab.
- `deployed_at` (String) When the deployment window begins (RFC 3339). Defaults to now server-side.
- `description` (String) Release notes / summary.
- `ended_at` (String) When the deployment window ends (RFC 3339). Null while in progress.
- `environment` (String) Deployment environment. Defaults to `production` server-side.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs this deployment explicitly targets. Empty = applies tenant-wide. Unordered.
- `pipeline_url` (String) Link to the CI/CD pipeline run.
- `service` (String) Optional service name used to scope the marker.
- `tags` (String) Comma-separated tags.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the marker was recorded (RFC 3339).
- `created_by_name` (String) Name of the user that recorded the deployment.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) User ID that recorded the deployment.
- `id` (String) Deployment marker ID.
- `is_in_progress` (Boolean) Whether the deployment window is still open (no `ended_at`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_deployment.example dep_marker_001
```
